name: Hanstone Gold Corp.
summary: Hanstone Gold Corp. acquires and explores for mineral properties in Canada. It primarily explores for gold and silver. The company holds 100% interest in the Doc Property which consist of 8 contiguous mineral claims covering an area of 1,704.23 hectares located in the Skeena Mining Division in northwest British Columbia; and holds 100% interest in the Snip North property comprising 5 mineral claims covering an area 3,336.59 hectares located in British Columbia. Hanstone Gold Corp. was incorporated in 2018 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
